script.description: Flatten dashboard fields without changing the original BBOT event
script.source: if (ctx.type == 'SCAN' && ctx.data_json != null) { if (ctx.data_json.name != null) ctx.scan_name = ctx.data_json.name; if (ctx.data_json.status != null) ctx.scan_status = ctx.data_json.status; if (ctx.data_json.status_code != null) ctx.scan_status_code = ctx.data_json.status_code; } if (ctx.type == 'URL' || ctx.type == 'URL_UNVERIFIED') { if (ctx.data_json != null) { if (ctx.data_json.url != null) ctx.event_url = ctx.data_json.url; if (ctx.data_json.status_code != null) ctx.url_status_code = ctx.data_json.status_code; if (ctx.data_json.http_title != null) ctx.http_title = ctx.data_json.http_title; } else if (ctx.data != null) { ctx.event_url = ctx.data; } } if (ctx.type == 'FINDING') { def finding = ctx.data_json != null ? ctx.data_json : ctx.data; if (finding instanceof Map) { if (finding.name != null) ctx.finding_name = finding.name; if (finding.description != null) ctx.finding_description = finding.description; if (finding.url != null) ctx.finding_url = finding.url; if (finding.host != null) ctx.finding_host = finding.host; if (finding.confidence != null) ctx.finding_confidence = finding.confidence.toString().toUpperCase(); if (finding.severity != null) { String severity = finding.severity.toString().toUpperCase(); if (severity == 'INFORMATIONAL') severity = 'INFO'; if (severity == 'MODERATE') severity = 'MEDIUM'; ctx.finding_severity = severity; def ranks = ['INFO': 1, 'LOW': 2, 'MEDIUM': 3, 'HIGH': 4, 'CRITICAL': 5]; ctx.severity_rank = ranks.containsKey(severity) ? ranks[severity] : 0; } } }
